result.summary: Detected a major accessibility contrast issue on the promo banner and a minor layout truncation issue on restaurant names.

issues.description: White text on a very light green background in the promo banner has poor color contrast.
issues.suggestion: Increase the text color contrast by using a darker green or gray shade for the text.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated abruptly on the right side.
issues.suggestion: Allow the text to wrap to a second line or reduce the font size slightly for longer names.
